stem:
[Image: Geometric figure with parallel lines and triangle]

In this figure, line l is parallel to line m. The measure of angle DAC is 55°.
What is the value of x + y?
figure_description: Two horizontal parallel lines are shown: line l on top and line m on the bottom. Points A and D lie on line l, with D to the right of A. Points B and C lie on line m, with C to the right of B. Line segments AB and AC connect the two lines, forming triangle ABC. A dashed arc indicates that angle DAC measures 55°. Inside triangle ABC, angle BAC at vertex A is marked with an arc labeled x°, and angle ABC at vertex B is marked with a dashed arc labeled y°.
